data.title: Multi-modal tokenizers
data.summary: Per-modality tokenizer choice, codebook layout, token-id namespacing, persistence format — the interface world-model-v0 consumes.

decisions_def.title: Open-MAGVIT2 plasma-domain decoder fine-tune — when to trigger?
decisions_def.context: Current ImageNet-pretrained decoder produces MAE 324 (uint16) on MAST rbb shot 15085. Expected rFID without fine-tune: 10–30. Decoder fine-tune cost: ~4–6 GPU-hours exclusive. Trigger gate (from plan): rFID > 5 on the 100-shot rbb benchmark.

decisions_def.title: PatchTST real embedding — defer to v1 vs land in v0?
decisions_def.context: Current state: identity passthrough (token ID 0, raw floats in metadata). Real PatchTST adds ~1M trainable params with channel-independent self-attention. Estimated effort: 1 Sonnet session.

decisions_def.title: Equilibrium 2-D tokenizer — which architecture?
decisions_def.context: Currently: equilibrium 2-D enters as a continuous cross-attention tensor (not tokenized). Option A — Open-MAGVIT2 at upsampled 256×256. Option B — Cosmos-Tokenizer-DV at native 65×65 (license check needed).

decisions_def.title: IR camera codebook — share with visible or allocate separate?
decisions_def.context: Only 25 rir shots in FAIR-MAST. Current v0 default: share the Open-MAGVIT2 visible codebook. Decision gate: if IR MAE > 2× rbb MAE, allocate separate block.

notes.body: Locked the 4 §12 decisions on tokenizers-12-landed; keeping the evergreen page's decision rows open so anyone reading the live doc sees what's in flight.
Drafted §12 expansion plan as 6 sub-items. Ranked by ROI; cross-modality alignment quality metric (§12.6) is the lowest-cost and worth landing first.
The Apache-2.0 constraint is non-negotiable. If Cosmos-Tokenizer-DV needs an NVIDIA OML license check, we're out — Option B becomes dead even if cheaper to ship.

questions.body: Should §12.4 use cosine on shared embeddings or per-modality InfoNCE? Need a 2-paragraph trade-off note before locking.
Does the §13.1 scaffold need to wait on §12.4 alignment improvements landing first, or are they independent?

followups.title: Run bulk-encode on rbb + magnetics shards (§12.5 follow-on)
followups.body: §13.3 landed the IR codebook benchmark wiring. To close §12.5 and unblock world-model-v0, we need the real bulk-encode pass across rbb (visible) + magnetics shards.
